result.instructions: Tools for BailaYa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which classes are on the schedule for this Saturday, and who teaches them?"; "Show me the active class packages and their prices."; "Add a salsa class for beginners next Tuesday at 19:00 in room 2, with capacity 12.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BailaYa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bailaya_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bailaya_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bailaya_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bailaya_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bailaya_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: List the studio's classes (scheduled occurrences) with date, time, instructor, room, capacity and price. Needs scope classes:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/classes.

limit.description: Rows per page (the API default applies if omitted).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Stop when a page is shorter than limit.

tools.name: bailaya_get_class

tools.description: Get one class by id. Needs scope classes:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/classes/{id}.

id.description: The id from the matching list tool.

tools.name: bailaya_create_class
tools.title: Create a class
tools.description: Create ONE class occurrence on a date. Visible on the studio's booking page. Needs scope classes:write. BailaYa API: POST /v1/classes.

team_member_id.description: The instructor's team member id. Must belong to the studio.

tools.name: bailaya_update_class
tools.title: Update a class
tools.description: Change fields of one class (time, instructor, room, capacity, price). Only the fields you pass change. Needs scope classes:write. BailaYa API: PATCH /v1/classes/{id}.

id.description: The id from the matching list tool.

tools.name: bailaya_delete_class
tools.title: Delete a class
tools.description: Delete (cancel) one class. Set apply_to_series to true to delete every occurrence of a repeating series. Irreversible. Needs scope classes:delete. BailaYa API: DELETE /v1/classes/{id}.

id.description: The id from the matching list tool.

apply_to_series.description: true = delete the whole recurring series. Default false: this occurrence only.
